# Ebda (ابدأ)

> Ebda is a self-serve online store builder for sellers in Egypt, built by Whisky 11 (https://whisky11.com). Arabic-first (RTL) with English. Merchants sign up, build and run their own store; every store gets a free <slug>.ebda.app address and can attach a custom domain.

Status: pre-launch. Pricing (EGP per month): Basic 1,490, Growth 3,490, Business 9,990; 25% off annual; 14-day Growth trial; no free plan; no commission on orders. Payment methods beyond cash on delivery, and shipping-carrier integrations, are marked "coming" on the site.

## Pages
- [Home (Arabic, Egyptian colloquial)](https://ebda.app/): how it works, features, payments and shipping, pricing, FAQ
- [Home (English)](https://ebda.app/en/): the same in English
- [Legal](https://ebda.app/legal/): company and legal notice (draft)
- [Privacy](https://ebda.app/privacy/): privacy policy (draft)
- [Terms](https://ebda.app/terms/): terms of service (draft)

## Facts
- Payments: cash on delivery; InstaPay with one merchant confirmation step; cards and wallets through Egyptian gateways are coming.
- WhatsApp: free click-to-chat (wa.me) links. Automated WhatsApp messaging is not available yet.
- Shipping: carrier integrations (Bosta, Aramex and others) are coming.
- Sign up: https://admin.ebda.app/signup
- Contact: support@ebda.app; security reports: security@ebda.app
